details: Wheelchairs: The main temple complex is built on flat ground-level terrain, making manual wheelchair movement manageable. Visitors should bring a personal foldable wheelchair as temple-provided options are limited.
Devasthanam Homeopathic Hospital: Free emergency medical aid, first-aid care, and treatment for sudden physical exhaustion are available at the dedicated temple-run Homeopathic Hospital.

Ground Floor Lodging Priority: Many older temple sadanams and local guest houses lack modern elevator lifts. Elderly travelers must explicitly request ground-floor room assignments at the time of booking.
